tokens.name: brand-bluette
tokens.usage: OE primary (Brand Manual 2025). Fixed in both themes. Use for brand surfaces, not as a chart fill on black (Bluette on black is not an official pairing).

tokens.name: brand-lime
tokens.usage: OE accent. Fixed in both themes. Never on white: 1.2:1. Fine on black (17.6:1) and on Bluette (9.3:1).

tokens.name: brand-bluette-900
tokens.usage: Bluette scale, darkest step. Sequential maps end here in the light theme.

tokens.name: brand-bluette-800
tokens.usage: Bluette scale.

tokens.name: brand-bluette-500
tokens.usage: Bluette scale.

tokens.name: brand-bluette-400
tokens.usage: Bluette scale. 4.9:1 on white, 4.3:1 on black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Exhibit background. White for reports (operative mode), black for dark pages.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Panels and table banding behind charts. Proposed (not in the Brand Manual).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Action titles, highlighted labels, values. 21:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, axis labels, sources, context labels. 7.6:1 on white, 8.8:1 on black. Proposed grey.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Gridlines and the footer hairline. Decorative only; never carries data.

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: Zero baselines and reference lines. 3.3:1 on white, 3.9:1 on black.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: TAG text (Atkinson Mono, uppercase): Bluette on light, Lime on dark, as the Brand Manual requires.

tokens.name: viz-highlight
tokens.usage: The ONE series, bar or point that proves the action title. Also its label colour. 11.1:1 on white, 17.6:1 on black.

tokens.name: viz-highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Ranges, bands and confidence areas around the highlighted series. Decorative: never the only carrier of a value.

tokens.name: viz-context
tokens.usage: Every series that is NOT the message. 3.3:1 on white, 3.9:1 on black, so it still reads as data.

tokens.name: viz-context-2
tokens.usage: Second context shade in stacked bars and Mekko. Below 3:1: only use where each segment is directly labelled.

tokens.name: viz-context-3
tokens.usage: Third context shade. Below 3:1: only with direct labels.

tokens.name: viz-up
tokens.usage: Waterfall increases. Same as highlight on purpose: growth is the usual story.

tokens.name: viz-down
tokens.usage: Waterfall decreases. Magenta from the secondary palette (darkened on white: 5.1:1). Avoids red/green.

tokens.name: viz-total
tokens.usage: Waterfall start and end totals.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical 1 when every series matters equally. Use at most 3 categorical colours at once.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical 2. Yellow from the secondary palette, darkened to ochre on white (3.9:1; original is 1.2:1).

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical 3. Cyan, darkened to teal on white (4.4:1; original is 1.2:1).

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical 4. Magenta, darkened on white (5.1:1; original is 2.7:1). Only with direct labels.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical 5. Green, darkened on white (3.8:1; original is 1.3:1). Similar lightness to cat-2 and cat-3: never next to them without labels.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, lowest class. Maps and heatmaps.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential scale.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential scale.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential scale.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential scale.

tokens.name: seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, highest class.

tokens.name: div-a3
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, far below the reference (ochre side). Ochre vs Bluette stays distinct for red-green colour blindness.

tokens.name: div-a2
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, below the reference.

tokens.name: div-a1
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, slightly below the reference.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint (the reference: Italy, regional average, target).

tokens.name: div-b1
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, slightly above the reference.

tokens.name: div-b2
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, above the reference.

tokens.name: div-b3
tokens.usage: Diverging scale, far above the reference (Bluette side).

tokens.name: viz-nodata
tokens.usage: Map areas with no data: surface fill with an axis-colour outline, labelled n.d. / n.a.

styles.name: action-title
styles.sample: Ogni 100 € investiti generano 146 € di valore aggiunto
styles.usage: The exhibit's action title: one complete sentence stating the finding. Max two lines. Report pages.

styles.name: action-title-slide
styles.sample: Southern GVA is still below its 2008 level
styles.usage: Action title when the exhibit fills a slide.

styles.name: exhibit-subtitle
styles.usage: Unit line under the title: measure, unit, period. No interpretation here.

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: Category and value labels on context series (ink-muted).

styles.name: data-label-strong
styles.usage: Label of the highlighted element (viz-highlight or ink).

styles.name: axis-label
styles.usage: Tick labels. Only when values are not labelled directly.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Il divario si è ridotto di 4 punti dal 2019
styles.usage: The so-what annotation: one short phrase pointing at one place in the chart.

styles.name: source-note
styles.usage: Source and notes under every exhibit. Mandatory.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Exhibit TAG above the title, always uppercase, in tag-ink (Brand Manual rule).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a bar end and its value label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between TAG, title and subtitle; label to axis.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between subtitle and chart; chart and footer.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Exhibit padding in reports.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Exhibit padding on slides.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked exhibits on a page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Bars, columns, Mekko cells, heatmap cells: square, as the brand's geometric blocks.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Map tiles and legend swatches.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Gridlines, footer rule, connectors.

tokens.name: stroke-context
tokens.usage: Context lines in line charts and slopegraphs.

tokens.name: stroke-highlight
tokens.usage: The highlighted line.
